items.title: Josh Jacobs: Set for limited practice work
items.description:
Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said that Jacobs (groin) is expected to go through limited team work during practice Monday, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Shedeur Sanders: Beginning season in backup role
items.description:
